Taldapatani 46 --- Page 7 --- TALATCHENGANI Ian angni skanggipa sechenggipa poedo ki-tap ong:a. Poedo seanirangna angni gisik nangbeaniara ku'tangko nambate man'na jotton ka'anioni ong-baaha.
Ku-tang ong'genchimoba ku-tangni me-suani aro (Garo) poraigen. Indiba ian namen dal-bea Achik chadamberangn1 gualani simsakbreja ine nikna man'a.
Pagitcham Poedo Segipa Pa.
Momin agana, "Darang do'an ku'tangko knatonikbata ina:" A-chikrangan de-genma! Iandakgipa ra bianiko gisiktango man-e anga ia chonbegipa poedo krtapko sena a-bachengaha.
Poedo seanirangko A-chik manderang bree poraina gisik nangbreja ine ma'sia. Indiba poedo seanirangan bang'a manderangni gisiko nangebata aro ka'tongo dongkambata.

Indake saniba janggi tanganio nangeanichi seanirangko ning-tue chanchi-bewalanirangkoba naata aro basakoba uni janggi tanganiko sol-na repna man:pila. Ia segimin poedorang badita manderangn1 anggi tanganio jakkaltobegipa ong:gen uko anga ma'sina amja.

la segimin katta bichongrang angni janggi tanganirango chanchianirangko naatbeaha; unigimin poedo seaniko namnikgipa aro chanchibewalna ranta ka'gipa manderangna gisik nangataniko on-chongmotgen ine ka-donga.

Minggipin, ia chasongni bang-bata A-chik poedo seanirango gitcham chasongn1 sebewalrango ong-bata ine nika. Aro, ma-ambin' kattarangko jakkalbrejaha ine nike iandakgipa kattarangko angn1 mitam poedorango ra'gatpile seanirangko dakaha.
Ia seanirang ka-donga. Ku'mande-Kujaleng ine ia poedo ki-tapko donani miksonganiara, ku-sikan gamchatbegipa jatrangni warachakani silchidare aro rama-jalang onga.
Ku-sikni gimin jat aro a'song atchia. Ia poedo ki-tapo adita bilsirangna an'tangni see chimonggimin poedorangoni mingkolatchisako chapa ka-atna baseaha.
A-chikku sea-jotanina on·timinti on'gilpana chanchian baksa kosako janapgimin miksonganio ia poedo ki-tapko chapa kaatenga.
Ku-ritingko see rakkianichi jatni ku'sikko ripingna aro ku-sik silroroan baksa Achik jatni sea-jotani kugipinni sea-jotanirangmung apsan gadango ong-bachina. Angni sika A chik Ku-sik Tangbangchina!

Mir Koknal Marak, MCS, Upper Chandmary, Tura --- Page 8 --- AGANDAPANI Pilak ku-sikrang aro jatrangon Ku-ritingogipa sea-jotani ba oral literature donga. Jekon, ku-sikchi aganritinganichi chasongni chasongna donrikrikanga.

Oral Literature-o bang'a rokonni sea-jotanirang gnang, chong:motan, golpo, rokomantini poedo seanirang, minganirang, poverb, folk gitrangkoba man'gopa. A-chikkuoba dingtang dingtang rokom aganritingao ripinggipa sea-jotanirang donga.
jekai, katta agana, dani, doro, ajea, kabe, folk gitrang, golpo, chera ring'ani, aganme-apa, aro uandake.

Iarangan chasongni chasongna pagitchamrangni kuritingchi ripingbagimin A.chikrangn gam onga. Americani Baptist missionary-rang skia man'gipa A-chikrangna Grammar, dictionary, aro primer-rangko A-we ku-sikchi seaha.
Jekon, A-chikku sea-jotanina ra'gatgimin standard ku-sik dake jakkalaha. Sastroko pe-anio aro mondolioba A-we ku-sikkon jakkalbataha.

Uandake, A-chikkuo pilak sea-jotanirango A-we ku'sikkon jakkale giproroangaha. Indiba ku-ritingchi ripingbagipa Ku'ritingogipa (oral literature) sea-jotani, sena jakkalgipa A-we ku'sikoni dingtang ong-a.
Iandakgipa rokomni A-chikkuo sea-jotanirang bon-kamgipa 19-gipa century-ni bakrango bang:roroaha.

Traditional ba pagitchamni sea-jotani aro Lekao Segimin sea-jotani (Written Literature) gisepo adita dingtanggrikanirang gnang. Traditional Literature ian aganritingbagimin, uni theme ba katta bichongko A-chik rang, namnikgipa epic poedorang, aro uamangni u'igipa legend-rang onga.

Minggipinara, lekao segimin, saksa mandechi segimin, segipa mandeni bimung gnang chapa ka-atgipa ong'a. Aro, lekao segimin sea-jotani 1an segipa mandeni chanchiatango banaigipa, an'tangni donggimin katta bichongo, an'tangni serongbewalo, aro jakkalna namnikgipa ku'sik ba kattako jakkale saksan mandechi segimin onga.

Indiba pagitchamni sea- jotaniara ku-sikchi aganritingbaanio on-rikrikbagipa, uko sawa sechengaha tangbange rakkigimin, uko jinmaan u-ia, aro uan jat gimikni gam ong'a. --- Page 9 --- Lekao segimin sea-jotani 1an segipa nokgipani an'tangni chanchiatango (idiolect) sea, uni seani bewalo (style), poedoo ba ku-akmao sean1 gimin rokomko dingtangmancha maekan1 gnang.

Indiba Ku-ritingogipa sea-jotani kattako jakkalanio, aganbewalo ba rokomo dingtangani komia: maina iandakgipa sea-jotaniko aganbewalo rakkian1 gimin aganritingachi dongrikrikgipa, aganako knae gisikoniko aganrikrikgipa ong skaa.

Indake lan knarikrikanio ripingako man'gimin ong'a. Pagitchamni (Traditional) aro Iekao Segimin (Written Literature) sea-jotanirang apsan ku-sikn1 sea-jotani ong-oha ia minggnian namen dingtanggrika; mitam pagitcham lekako segipa manderangko grongrike sandianiko daknaba chol dongjaha.
I.cka-pora gnanggiparang A-chik pagitchamrang Ku'ritingogipa (Oral Literature) sca-jotanina bate ku siktango ki'taprangko seanina gisik on-bataha. Indiba Pa Jobang D.
Marak aro Pa Simison R. Sangmaoni a-bachenge kurriungo aganritinggipa Achikku sea-jotaniko kolame seaniko a-hachengalaha aro uni gamchatanikoba ma'sibataha.
Uamangn ja-mano Pa Dhoronsing K Sangma aro Pa Dewansing Rongmuthu A-chik Folklore-rangko chimonge ki-taprangko chapa ka-ataha.
Uamangko ja'rike Pa Aldrich (h. Momin aro Pa.
Mihir N Sangma A-chik jaini dakbewal (culture) aro maniani bewalrangko am'sandianiko dake aganani aro minganirangko chimonge ki-taprangko nakatchengaha. Pagitcham (Traditional) sca-jotanirango Pa.
Monensing R. Sangma Ku'ritingogipa A·chikni katta bichongko (theme) ra'e poedorangko seaha.
Pa Mir K Marakni poedorang Pa.

Monensing R Sangmani poedorangoni dingtanga. Uni seani katta bichongrang (theme) ma'gitchani-pagitchamni bebera-anirango pangchakja, uni seani bewalrang aro ku-sikko jakkalan ku-ritingogipa sea-jotanina sepanganiko nikna man'a.
Indiba an'tangni katta bichongo, chanchiatango, an·tangni jakkalgipa ku'sikko done aro an'tangn1 seani bewalo (style) seaha. Mir K.

Marak, ia chasongn1 saksa ku-siktangko mande ragipa, gamchatnikgipa aro u-ina sikgipa ong-a ine ma'sina man-a. Uni College-o poraimitingo porairimskarang Garo subjectko skigipa dongjani gimin Garoni pal Alternative English-ko baseaha.
Indiba ia neng'nikanirangko changija Ku-siktangko gamchatnike, mikkangchina namgni ong'gen ine chanchie Garoko baseaha.

Indake A-chikkuo seanina gisik nanggipaba ong-aha. Uni --- Page 10 --- segimin poedorang miksonganiko parakna seskelanisan ongja; indiba simsake, miksongatangko name talatna somo ra'e, parakna jotton ka-aha.
Mesokani gita - “Aman' Ku'sik" poedoo ua ku'siktangna ka'saani, gamchatani aro knatoaniko de-doe aganaha. Poedo segipa Pa.
Mir K. Marakn1 seani uni an'tangn bewalo (style) seaha.

Uni seanirango A-chik pagitchamni sebewalrango seaniko(characteristics) nika, jekai, ma-kete seani, morpheme-rangko gital dake dondime katta gital banaiani, namnikatang gita, uni chanchian1 aro miksongatangko parakna, kattarangni ortoko apalbatatani (extension of meaning), agananiosan donggipa (spoken language) kattarangko ampiltaie nangani kri jakkalaniko nikna man-a.

'Kakket' poedoko seani bidingo indake mesokna man gen, katta agana doroani riting gita, indiba inditan ia ritingrangko ma-kete sea. la ritingrangko dokbadale sena man gen, jekal, “"Kakket" poedoo - Saln1 teng'a teng'rakjake, mikbokanio, Dongja sandiani jattang an-chitang Dongja baseani ma'a-no ine.

Chipkamatjok karin' suk a'sakni, Suakama dikdikon dongkamgijanirang, Bangbango gitchoe pangchakan1 gri; Tang-bingbanga skatgija bal bala baksa. Methapor simile aro symbolrangko jakkan ritingrangko kan-dikatna aro ma-ketatna jakkalani, jekai, Miknian sal ja-dil sue ka'tong silgrakkoba.

- "Chadamben' Gisik" Rakkia A song-chiga, Niamko mikchepja, Dangtapja on'titi, jotdikja saksaba, Mikkongjim-ja'takkim, chi indik Kos1. - "Ang'A-chuna" Ku-ritingogipa (Oral Poetry) poedorang gita katta done function- wordrangko jakkalani.
Uni seanirang chanchiatangni bimangko (Image- rangko) jakkale ritingrangko donani, jekai, Chri goa wa'pong sika, nangchin' chengonin, Tosusao nikja-sokja bilak-wa'sabatako;
